Empowering Farmer-Rancher Prosperity through Reliable Agriculture Solutions
At Frenchman Valley Coop, we’re more than just a cooperative; we’re a community. Serving patrons in Kansas, Nebraska, Colorado, and Wyoming, we are committed to providing top-notch agricultural solutions. Our goal is to empower our members and contribute to their success through our quality services in feed, energy, agronomy, and grain management. Join us, and let’s grow together.
Our Services Careers
Careers
And Internships
Aspiring to make a difference in the agricultural sector? Join our team! At Frenchman Valley Coop, we offer exciting career and internship opportunities for those passionate about agriculture and eager to contribute to a thriving cooperative. We’re not just offering a job; we’re inviting you to be part of a family that values hard work, innovation, and service. Be proud of your work; be proud of your Coop.
Join our team
Partners in Agricultural Excellence
At Frenchman Valley Coop, service isn’t just a word; it’s our commitment. Every decision, every innovation, every interaction is driven by our dedication to serving our patrons. We take pride in not only meeting but exceeding expectations, ensuring that our community and members always come first.

Don’t Take Our Word For It
“I want to express my satisfaction with Frenchman Valley Coop’s Harness Diesel fuels. Whether it’s in my over the road trucks, using clear Frenchman Valley Coop’s diesel, or in my farm equipment using Frenchman Valley Coop’s Farm diesel, I haven’t encountered any injector or starting problems. This winter, I plan to use some of Frenchman Valley Coop’s Harness Winter blend to ensure my equipment starts and runs at their best. I wholeheartedly recommend Frenchman Valley Coop’s fuels to anyone running diesel equipment.”
Terry Martin
“I’ve been using Frenchman Valley Coop’s Harness fuel in my truck exclusively for quite a while now and I’m happy to say that not only have I not experienced any injector problems with my engine, I have also noticed a small improvement in the mileage. Cold starts also seem better since I started using their Harness fuel. I would definitely recommend it to anyone utilizing diesel fuel.”
Darwin Warning
